== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}} 
Joseph was born about 1849. He was the son of [[Glasgow-2573|Joseph Glasgow]] and [[Gilbert-25488|Lucy Gilbert]].

On 27 Nov 1878, in Lynchburg, Virginia, he married Judy Ann Jackson (1848-1939, daughter of David & Rachel Castle).<ref>'''Marriage''': "Virginia, Marriages, 1785-1940", , FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XRJW-H48 : 29 January 2020), Joseph Glasgow, 1878.</ref> They had the following known children.
#Lelia Bell Glasgow b. 1883 - d. 1958, unmarried
#Carrie Glasgow b. 1885 - d. 1907, unmarried

He passed away in 1914, in Lynchburg.<ref>'''Death''': "Virginia, Death Certificates, 1912-1987", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QVRQ-KGQQ : Wed Oct 08 17:37:05 UTC 2025), Entry for Joseph R Glasgow and Jas Glasgow, 25 Feb 1914.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2573]] is assessed at 91% (proved). The held accounts connect this child to Joseph Glasgow and Lucy Gilbert’s Roanoke family, citing the 1866 cohabitation register. Joseph was informant at the elder Joseph’s death and belongs to the held cohabitation-register family; his own death index’s Jas Glasgow rendering requires checking.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect 1866 row37 including children, then compare the child’s marriage/death parent fields.

Source basis already held: [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X5Y6-54C Death: "Virginia, Deaths and Burials, 1853-1912", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X5Y6-54C : 29 January 2020), Joseph Glasgo, 1877.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
